about.title: Established in 2006, and still on time.
text: Lumens Electric is a Houston electrical contractor serving homeowners, property managers and commercial clients. We know your time is valuable, which is why we are committed to being on time to our appointments.

We are knowledgeable in all residential and commercial electrical installations and repairs, and we take the time to fully understand what the customer is trying to accomplish, as well as to offer advice when we see fit. We provide up front pricing and start work only after the customer understands, in writing, the service we are going to provide, including the total cost. Estimates on new construction and remodels are free.

The business is owned by Pablo Rios Jr., who has 34 years of experience in the electrical field and extensive knowledge of residential and commercial projects. He is NCCER Certified and was an Electrical Technology Instructor at Houston Community College under Tom Tynan. He believes in listening to the needs and concerns of his customers first and then offering his recommendation, and that trust is one of the greatest attributes a man can have.

faqs.q: Do I need to hurry to replace aluminum wiring?
faqs.a: No. If the wires were so harmful your home would not still be standing, so it is not something to stop what you are doing over. The main reason people have it done is that some insurance companies could refuse to pay over fire damages if the home still has aluminum wiring.

faqs.q: How often should I have my home inspected?
faqs.a: The go-to answer is that yearly inspections are a good idea. If you have older equipment and wiring at home you could be more at risk, and may want to consider more inspections per year or outright changing the wiring and appliances.

faqs.q: How much damage does installing a ceiling fan do to the ceiling?
faqs.a: We do have to drill and run the wiring inside walls and ceilings, and our certified electricians go to great lengths to ensure whatever is done to the ceiling is either covered up by the fan itself or properly repaired.

faqs.q: How long does a ceiling fan installation take?
faqs.a: If we are removing one fan and putting in another, there is a good chance we can do it within the hour. Otherwise it depends on how long it takes to hook up the wiring in the exact spot you need the fan placed.

faqs.q: How do I work out what size generator I need?
faqs.a: Make a list of the appliances you would most need to keep running in an outage. People typically name the AC, the fridge and a pump for clean water, which would need a generator providing at least 6910 starting watts and 3610 running watts.

faqs.q: Do you charge for an estimate?
faqs.a: We provide free estimates on new construction and remodels. You can also request a free quote through the contact form or by calling (713) 649-7800.
